_comment: The goal is to move Google-app updates from the device's first boot to build time,
so a freshly flashed GSI does not have to download+reinstall+re-dexopt hundreds of MB
of Play Services / Play Store right after setup.
'signer_sha256' is Google's release cert. Every downloaded APK MUST match it or it is
rejected, which is what keeps the ;PRESIGNED entries valid and guarantees authenticity.
'max_sdk' is the running platform API level (Android 14 = 34). We only accept an APK
whose minSdk is <= this, so we never seed a build that refuses to run on the target.
'arches' are the arch trees to update. The shipped Google target (arm64_bgN) is arm64
only; arm and x86_64 are kept for completeness and only updated if a matching multi-abi
_trim_comment: Optional Google apps removed from the seed set so there is less to auto-update and
re-dexopt on first boot. Each entry lists the proprietary-files-*.txt line to drop and
the on-disk APK dir to delete. After trimming, setup-makefiles.sh is re-run to
Remove an entry here to KEEP that app.
